steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Your tea, my lady.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: *sigh* What a pity that after tomorrow, it will be quite some time before I can drink your tea again.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Once I complete my duty as instructor this year, I'll apply for a reassignment.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: You should be saying something like 'since my lady wishes it, I'll never leave your side'!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Then I'll submit my resignation later.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Please don't. If you really did resign, the people on the landship would hold a huge grudge against me.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Alright, I should be heading to the office. You'll be at the Public Security Bureau today, right?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Yes. Charlie has been busy lately thanks to a band of bandits. He's asked me to help lead some newcomers, so I'll be heading over shortly.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: See you for dinner, then.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: The 'White Volcano', 6:00 P.M.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I know!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Sir?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Are you free right now, Schwarz?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Charlie's got a job for me, but I've got some time until then.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: There's something about Ceylon I'd like your opinion on. I'm at the 'White Volcano'.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Sir.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Time really flies, doesn't it Schwarz?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Back in the day, Barbara and I would kill time in eateries like this.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: You've never mentioned that.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: There are a lot of things I never mention in this heart of mine. I've no real appetite to talk about them.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: But look where that got me. My own daughter had to learn about her mother from someone else.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I need to take responsibility.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: You're thinking of discussing her mother with her?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: A birthday party could be a good opportunity.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I'm just scared she won't want to hear me out.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: She will.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: You just need to steel your mind and endure her anger.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Haha, I suppose you're right.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I'll have to prepare myself and tell her more about her mother, then.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Ah, yes. It must have been around '66. That year, Victoria was giving everyone in Parliament a big headache.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: At the time, Barbara was up on the volcano doing some research. There wasn't any signal there, so I couldn't contact her easily.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I'd promised her I'd meet her at the foot of the volcano on our wedding anniversary, then we'd head to a restaurant in town.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: But in the end, I was stuck in a government conference.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Hmm?

steps.name: Herman's Voice
steps.text: By the time I got to the volcano, it was already getting dark, and we missed our reservation.

steps.name: Herman's Voice
steps.text: I felt really bad because I'd ruined our anniversary.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: *whispers* Heh, sucker.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: But she wasn't even angry. Instead, she comforted me.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: As I gazed at her side profile in the warm glow of the setting sun, everything suddenly became clear. I picked a few flowers from the roadside—

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Ah, not Volcano Watchers, just the ordinary kind that grows all over the foot of the volcano.
As Herman speaks, he takes the decorative flower out of his drink as though living out his past, and hands it to the person who happens to stand next to him.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I tucked the flowers into her hair, then presented my anniversary gift, a ring.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: What do you think? Should I tell her this story?

steps.name: Waitress
steps.text: Um, thank you for the flower, Mr. Mayor...

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Hmm? Where's Schwarz?

steps.name: Waitress
steps.text: I'm not too sure myself. I heard a commotion, so I came from the kitchen to have a look.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: Let go of me!

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Your wallet, sir.

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: What the—?! You little punk!

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: You're coming with me to the Public Security Bureau!

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: No I'm not, let go of me!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Allow me to handle him, sir.

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Who're you?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: She's with the PSB.

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: And who... err, you must be Mayor Herman, right?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Trust me, you can leave it to the young lady.

steps.name: Tourist
steps.text: Of course, if you say so, Mr. Mayor.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: You can go now, boy.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: You're not going to lock me up?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Do you want me to?

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Then go.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: If I catch you again, I'll take you somewhere much worse.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: Hmph. Don't think I'm scared of you.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Why let him go?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: There was mineral dust on his shoes, and his clothes didn't seem to fit...

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Also, I saw crystals on his body when I grabbed him. Originium.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: You think he might be connected to the workers illegally digging up obsidian?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: If so, why not leave it to the Bureau?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Charlie knows what to do.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: He might not.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: When I returned, I dropped by the PSB.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: You think he's doing a bad job?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: No, he's done everything I asked him to before I left.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: But I hadn't thought of everything back then.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: We still have time, at least.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Lady Ceylon mentioned a Mr. Pelipper to me. I'm thinking of having a chat with him.

steps.name: Pelipper
steps.text: Private obsidian mining?

steps.name: Pelipper
steps.text: You've got the wrong guy, lady.

steps.name: Pelipper
steps.text: The volcano's already erupted. Who in their right mind would go against the mayor's decision now?

steps.name: Pelipper
steps.text: Everyone's on board now.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: The eruption's just ended. To some, this is their best chance of striking it rich.

steps.name: Pelipper
steps.text: You think they bribed some miners into mining obsidian for them?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Pelipper
steps.text: And if I don't tell you, will it be my turn to be in a whole lot of trouble, former PSB chief Schwarz?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: No, I'll go look for them myself.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Boss, I've got the newcomers dressed up as miners, like you asked.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: From now on, forget being Bureau men. You're just a group of miners risking the volcano's heat.

steps.name: Miners?
steps.text: Yes, ma'am!

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Using them to draw out the bandits, boss?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: No, I want them to learn what life in the mines is really like.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: If they happen to draw out the bandits, then all the better.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Mind if I ask why?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: They need to understand what the private obsidian miners actually do to solve this problem once and for all.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Is this... another one of Lady Ceylon's ideas?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: It does sound like something she'd say.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: But no. It's one of mine.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Got it. I'll get changed into a miner's outfit myself.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Let's head out first. You can change on the way.

steps.name: Pelipper
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Pelipper
steps.text: I told Lady Ceylon that if she ever needed something done, I'd help.

steps.name: Pelipper
steps.text: And it seems to me like helping you is helping her.

steps.name: Pelipper
steps.text: So leave it to me. I'll pull some strings.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: You guys new here?

steps.name: Miner ???
steps.text: What'd ya say, kid?

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: Hey, show me a little respect!

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: Without me leading the way, you'd never find any obsidian!

steps.name: Miner ???
steps.text: S-Sorry!

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: So, what's your pathetic reason for risking so much to mine obsidian?

steps.name: Miner ???
steps.text: The work that Pelipper fella got us barely paid us a dime, and we really need the cash...

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: Hmph, that's what they all say. That Herman guy's real stupid too. He's sitting on a gold mine but won't do anything with it.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: You guys know the rules?

steps.name: Miner ???
steps.text: Of course. Never tell, never fear death.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: Not bad. We're nothing like that Pelipper poser. If you dig something up, we'll pay you.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: Follow me. There's more of your buddies down there.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: You'll be working here.

steps.name: Miner ???
steps.text: Right, of course.
The boy heads deeper into the cave. Little does he know, there is a pair of eyes watching him intently as he disappears into the darkness.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: It's me.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter On Watch
steps.text: How's the fresh meat?

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: This new batch seems pretty strong. Should be able to dig up plenty.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter On Watch
steps.text: Good to hear. Head on in.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter On Watch
steps.text: ...Hmm?

steps.name: Bounty Hunter On Watch
steps.text: Thought I felt something go by.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter On Watch
steps.text: Nah, how could anyone else be down here? Must be the mine getting to me.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: *whispers* Just as expected.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: *whispers* This camp was clearly built after the eruption. They must have already infiltrated the mining community if they could find somewhere this deep so fast.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: *whispers* About twenty people in total.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: *whispers* That boy should be up ahead.

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Heard you went out into the city today.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: H-how'd you know?

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: I thought I warned you not to go into town just 'cause you feel like it? You'd draw unwanted attention.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: You guys won't give me any cash, and you won't let me get any fresh air either! I'm suffocating down here!

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: You nearly got caught by the most dangerous woman in town, you know that?

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Dunno what got into her to let you go, though.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: Is she really that bad?

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Hah! Why do ya think we're hiding down here? We're trying not to piss that demon off.

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Then there's Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Good thing I've almost made enough.

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Go tell the boys to get ready to unload.

steps.name: Strong Bounter Hunter
steps.text: Finally! I'm getting cooked alive in this hellhole!

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: 'Unload'... What's that mean?

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Well, since you wanna be one of us, kid, I suppose I should tell you.

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: 'Unloading' means we're gonna kill all those miners down there, grab all their obsidian and cash, then scram.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: Why do we have to kill them? Some of them just joined!

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Well, too bad for them.

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: If you wanna be in our line of work, this is one thing you've gotta learn.

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Never leave any loose ends.

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: They've seen you, you've seen us.

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: So if you'd rather be one of us instead of dying by my blade...

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Then they've gotta die.

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Don't forget who pulled you out of the mines after your ma and pa died.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: I know, but...

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: You were the one who said you didn't want to end up like them, busting their asses for pennies! You wanted to strike it rich!

steps.name: Cruel Bounty Hunter
steps.text: You got that? If you do, give me a proper answer!

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: Y-You're that lady from before—

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I told you that if I saw you again, I'd take you somewhere much worse than the Public Security Bureau.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: I-I don't want to kill those miners!

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: They're just like my mom and dad! I-I was just giving them a scare for fun!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: The time is... 15:20.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I could still make it if I hurry.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Close your eyes, kid.

steps.name: Cunning Boy
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: It's best if you don't see what happens next.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Never mind.
Before the boy can react, Schwarz moves to his side, knocks him out with a neat blow, and carries his stunned body onto her shoulder.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: It's quicker this way.
In the distance, screams echo through the cave. The traps she set up beforehand are working. But louder still is the sound of footsteps gradually approaching.
It reminds her of the night she wiped out her enemies.
She was alone back then, outnumbered ten-to-one.
She realizes that if there were a child with her back then, she wouldn't have wasted time like the way she did earlier.
But now, what used to be a waste of time feels as right as breathing.

steps.name: Miner ???
steps.text: Y-You actually took out all those bandits on your own?!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: As I told Charlie, split into two teams. One to sweep the bandits' den, the other to calm the miners.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Got it?

steps.name: Miner ???
steps.text: On it, boss!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Miner ???
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Take this boy—

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: He has Oripathy. Allow me to examine him.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Put him down here, will you? The rocks are more even here.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Why are you here, my lady?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: If Mr. Pelipper hadn't been worried enough to give me a call, I'm afraid I would have been in the dark about all this.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I could have handled this myself.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: The disease hasn't spread very far. He must have been infected only recently.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Could you take him to Rhodes Island's office?

steps.name: Miner ???
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: What happened to him?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: His parents were private obsidian miners who died in a mining accident. With no one to look after him, he caught the eye of those bandits.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Gangs like them love taking in kids like him.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I heard a lot of stories like that aboard Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: He's stubborn. I'm afraid he won't be changing his ways anytime soon.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Then what do you think we should do?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I'm thinking of handing him over to the Rhodes Island office in Siesta.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Caring for those with Oripathy is our duty, not to mention the fact that he's an orphan.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: So sure, you can count on us to figure things out.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Well, that's all sorted then.
With those words, Ceylon claps her hands and smiles.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: How about you? Are you hurt?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: It was just some bandits.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I noticed the boy was unharmed too. Your doing?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: If you didn't have to look after him, how much quicker do you think you could have cleared out the bandits?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I'd say... ten minutes quicker, at least.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I might have been able to make it to your birthday party.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Don't worry, it's not as if I'd really be mad at you for something like that.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I'm rather happy, in fact.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: You are?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I know what you were like before.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: It took me quite a while to get used to that side of you, just like it took you quite a while to get used to living with me.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: We've changed thanks to one another, but we've also learned to live with some of each other's stubbornness.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Like my obsession with Oripathy, or how you handle things.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I keep hoping you'll come back to New Siesta, and yet, there's a part of me that's afraid. Afraid that once we work together, we'd start butting heads.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Will we?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Not anymore, from the look of things.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: So, I'll be waiting for you.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Anyways...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: It's 5:30, and it'll take at least an hour to get to the 'White Volcano'.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I think we can consider my birthday party a bust.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Master Herman is most likely waiting at the restaurant to throw you a nice surprise. If we go now, we can still make it in time.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: He's kept me waiting for this long, I'm sure he can handle a little longer.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: So, where's my present?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: And I'm not letting you off with an excuse like 'there was no time to get one.'
She returns her lady's gaze, a rare tinge of embarrassment in her eyes.
This is just how Ceylon is. Whatever she wants, she'll fight for it.
She has in fact prepared a gift. Right now, it should still be in the jewelry store in the commercial district.
If they head over there now, then to the 'White Volcano' right after, they should still be able to make it.
Schwarz plans to tell Ceylon that, but then she sees her face, outlined in the sunset's afterglow.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: What is it, Schwarz?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I see what Master means now.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Are these... flowers?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Don't move, my lady.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Let me tuck them into your hair.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Is this my present?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Wildflowers from the foot of the volcano.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: While they might not have the same meaning as Volcano Watchers, the fact that they can bloom under the volcano at all is proof of their tenacity.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: The volcano represents Siesta, and from here, you can see all the sights the city has to offer, both Old and New.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Besides, ordinary wildflowers have their own meaning.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: We're all just ordinary people living at the foot of the volcano.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: But most importantly, they're beautiful.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I'll let you off the hook this time.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Apparently Master Herman did this once to patch up a rough spot in his marriage.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Really now?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Mother must have had the same thought as I did then.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: You could ask him yourself.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I feel like you've been taking his side a lot lately, Schwarz.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: He has been waiting too.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I know, I know. I'll have a proper chat with him.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Let's go, I'm starving.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: You're free tomorrow, right? I'll help you pack. There are a few gifts I was hoping you could help deliver to some friends on the landship.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Speaking of gifts, what kind of cake did you get?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Chocolate hazelnut. You said you wanted to try it last week.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: That's my Schwarz!

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Ah... Ah-choo!

steps.name: Waitress
steps.text: Oh, Mr. Mayor! Why are you here all by yourself?

steps.name: Waitress
steps.text: I thought tonight was Miss Ceylon's birthday party?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Something came up on Schwarz's side, so my daughter went to help her.

steps.name: Waitress
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Waitress
steps.text: Will it be alright if you don't head over yourself?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: By the time I found out, Schwarz had already settled the matter, and Ceylon was already there.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: All I can do is wait for them here.

steps.name: Waitress
steps.text: Well, as long as they're safe.

steps.name: Waitress
steps.text: Oh, what's that you're holding—

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Wildflowers. Went to the foot of the volcano today to pick them.

steps.name: Waitress
steps.text: That explains why they look so familiar.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: A long time ago, they helped me settle a rocky moment with my wife.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Today, I hope they can help me break the ice with my daughter.

steps.name: Waitress
steps.text: You've planned this plenty well, so why still the long face, Mr. Mayor?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I had a feeling just now.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: A feeling that this little trick of mine isn't going to help this time.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: ...But why?
